name: Nephrity Eolarn
source: Nephrity is the daughter of the king of Eolarn and Nerion's younger sister. The kingdom is at war with the Valenians, so the king has sent his children to their summer residence to protect them. Unfortunately, someone has betrayed them and the residence has been seized. They managed to escape and try to return to the main palace without being noticed; but it will certainly be a long and perilous journey...
